story: I'm Sabrina Muqadas, a Growth & Business Development Executive who builds pipeline across four channels: Upwork bidding, LinkedIn social selling, email outreach and cold calling.
My focus is multi-channel B2B and B2C lead generation, client acquisition and AI-driven workflow optimization for technology companies in the USA, UK, UAE and KSA.

My path began in talent acquisition and content at DEFT Recruiter, sourcing and screening candidates for oil and gas roles across the Gulf. That grounding in communication, qualification and the Gulf market still shapes how I approach every prospect.

At Sigma Digital Solutions I led lead generation and data management as KYCIER Team Lead: qualifying leads with Sales Navigator, Apollo and RocketReach, running UI/UX and SEO audits, and mentoring teammates on pipeline tracking. Strong results in data optimization and client engagement led to my promotion to Upwork Bidder, where I wrote tailored proposals, optimized profiles and catalogs, and used AI tools to move faster.

In 2026 I broadened into outbound cold calling at AEITCH and joined ISOTOPE as Growth & Business Development Executive, pitching AI products, Python development, DevOps infrastructure and full-stack applications to international clients.

I translate technical requirements into clear solutions, manage pipelines in HubSpot and Salesforce, and use AI tools such as ChatGPT and Grok to maximize campaign ROI, while keeping the data clean and the conversations human.

growthStrategy.title: Market & Account Research
growthStrategy.description: Understanding the markets, industries and accounts where a company wants to grow, before a single message is sent.

Map industries, competitors and service demand
Source business data from LinkedIn, Apollo, ZoomInfo and public listings

growthStrategy.title: ICP & Decision-Maker Mapping
growthStrategy.description: Defining the right-fit client, what they need and who makes the buying decision.
activities: Build ideal customer profiles from company data
Identify decision-makers with Sales Navigator
Profile target accounts before outreach
growthStrategy.outcome: A shared definition of the right client that sharpens targeting and messaging.

growthStrategy.title: Prospecting & Data Enrichment
growthStrategy.description: Finding matching companies and contacts, then enriching and qualifying them before anyone is contacted.

Enrich contacts with RocketReach and verify them
Qualify against the profile and keep data clean

growthStrategy.title: Multi-Channel Outreach
growthStrategy.description: Starting relevant conversations through the right channel, with a message tailored to the prospect.
activities: Personalized LinkedIn social selling and email sequences
Cold calling with a softphone for high-volume campaigns
Case-study content to earn inbound interest
growthStrategy.outcome: Quality conversations with the right decision-makers, from more than one angle.

growthStrategy.title: Discovery & Qualification
growthStrategy.description: Listening first: understanding goals, constraints and scope before recommending anything.
activities: Ask structured discovery questions on calls and in messages
Clarify scope, goals and constraints
Book qualified discovery meetings and interviews
growthStrategy.outcome: A requirement picture clear enough to propose the right solution.

growthStrategy.title: Proposals & Negotiation
growthStrategy.description: Turning requirements into a clear, tailored proposal and supporting the conversation through to agreement.
activities: Write tailored Upwork bids, proposals and catalogs
Pitch AI, Python, DevOps, web and mobile solutions in the client's language
Support negotiation and coordinate with delivery teams
growthStrategy.outcome: Relevant, clear proposals and a smoother path to a signed contract.

growthStrategy.title: CRM & Pipeline Management
growthStrategy.description: Keeping every opportunity visible, with clean data and timely follow-ups.
activities: Track every touchpoint in HubSpot and Salesforce
Follow up and move opportunities toward close
Hand over cleanly to the delivery team
growthStrategy.outcome: Fewer missed follow-ups and a pipeline the whole team can trust.

growthStrategy.title: ROI Analysis & Optimization
growthStrategy.description: Reviewing what worked and what did not, then feeding the learning back into the next cycle.
activities: Review pipeline, proposal and campaign performance
Refine targeting, messaging and profiles
Use AI tools and scripts to automate repeatable steps
growthStrategy.outcome: Learning that feeds back into stage one, so the process improves each cycle.
